messages:
ana: Quick field-summary from the GPTQ bring-up across Llama/Mistral/Qwen — kept it lightweight, TL;DR + action items below. ran MMLU, GSM8K, LAMBADA, TruthfulQA, Winogrande and a small instruction-suite.
raj: awesome, please paste numbers.
ana: paste incoming. baseline = fp16 v.s. quant variants (gptq-4, gptq-8, awq-4, awq-8, int8-fp8*). note: fp8 experiments were noisy due to optimizer differences; marked separately.
morgan: re: noisy — did you freeze LN params + disable per-layer fmad optimizations? that helped last time.
ana: yes, LN frozen. used the same compilation flags for all runs. scripts & configs: https://internal-gists.redwood/quant/bringup-174855
sasha: put the key table pls.
ana: 
```
Model                 | Task    | FP16  | GPTQ-4 | GPTQ-8 | AWQ-4 | AWQ-8
Llama-2-13B-ot        | MMLU    | 73.6  | 72.1 (-1.5) | 73.0 (-0.6) | 71.9 (-1.7) | 73.2 (-0.4)
Llama-2-13B-ot        | GSM8K   | 54.2  | 52.8 (-1.4) | 53.9 (-0.3) | 52.5 (-1.7) | 53.8 (-0.4)
Mistral-7B-v0         | MMLU    | 68.9  | 66.1 (-2.8) | 67.5 (-1.4) | 65.8 (-3.1) | 67.1 (-1.8)
Mistral-7B-v0         | LAMBADA | 39.7  | 36.5 (-3.2) | 38.8 (-0.9) | 36.2 (-3.5) | 38.5 (-1.2)
Qwen-14B               | MMLU    | 75.8  | 74.7 (-1.1) | 75.4 (-0.4) | 74.2 (-1.6) | 75.6 (-0.2)
Qwen-14B               | TruthQA | 61.4  | 60.9 (-0.5) | 61.2 (-0.2) | 60.5 (-0.9) | 61.3 (-0.1)
```
*numbers are percentage points; parenthetical is delta vs FP16. quick notes: GPTQ-4 gives largest win on memory but often 1–3pt MMLU drop on Mistral; GPTQ-8 and AWQ-8 converge close to FP16 in most tasks.
raj: interesting that Qwen is robust. does that map to KV layout differences?
ana: yes — Qwen's key/value mat shapes and single-headed kv patch meant less quant noise in attention matmuls. Mistral has many small kernels that amplify roundoff on low-bit.
morgan: perf/deploy numbers?
ana: throughput/ram roughs (single A100-40G-like equivalent):
- Llama-2-13B fp16: 1.0x baseline tps, 28GB mem
- GPTQ-4: 2.6x tps, 7.2GB mem (kv cache encoded), 3.5x cost-efficiency
- GPTQ-8: 1.8x tps, 12.4GB mem
- AWQ-4: 2.4x tps, 8.0GB mem (slightly more transient allocations)
- Qwen-14B fp16: 0.85x tps, 44GB mem
- Qwen-14B GPTQ-4: 2.1x tps, 12GB mem
ana: caveat: GPTQ-4 requires custom kernel fallback for some ops (we disabled fused rotary for a few layers). tests flagged a tiny decoding-rate variance — reproducible on long-context stories (LAMBADA).
sasha: any quality regressions beyond numbers? hallucination, instruction-following?
ana: yes — two callouts:
- instruction-tuned variants (alpaca-style) show a small rise in refusal errors with GPTQ-4 (more on Mistral). when compared on our instruction-eval set, helpfulness dropped ~2–4 points.
- numeric reasoning on GSM8K drops consistently for low-bit on Mistral, less so on Llama and Qwen.
raj: should we block GPTQ-4 rollout on Mistral for customer-facing dedicated nodes?
morgan: propose this policy:
- Mistral: recommend GPTQ-8 or AWQ-8 in Dedicated; GPTQ-4 only for internal batch/offline workloads with eval gating.
- Llama / Qwen: allow GPTQ-4 for latency-sensitive tiers but require nightly quality smoke tests (instruction + math).
ana: +1. created a canary job pipeline: `canary/quant/gptq-smoke` — runs 10k tokens across instruction set + 500 GSM8K shards. will gate with threshold MMLU >= baseline-2.0 and GSM8K >= baseline-3.0.
```
ci-bot: canary/quant/gptq-smoke finished: 2023 passed, 17 failed. failing samples logged: https://internal-ci/reports/174855/canary
```
ana: failed samples are mostly Mistral-GPTQ-4 numeric edgecases and a few prompt-injection style instruction failures.
sasha: ok. next steps?
ana: action items:
- morgan: add per-layer abs-quant-error logging to the compile pipeline (PR in review)
- raj: help add AWQ-8 as default artifact for mistral dedicated pools for now
- sasha: craft customer-facing note for Dedicated early adopters (brief: performance gains, recommended configs, known regressions)
- ana: run fp8 stabilization sweep next week (different scaler and micro-optim)
morgan: starting the per-layer logging now.
raj: will open the AWQ-8 rollout ticket.
sasha: drafting note, will ping legal for wording.
ana: thanks — I'll post a short internal doc with these tables + raw eval CSVs. ping me for deeper dives. :thumbsup:
